_ghi_chu: Workflow SDXL + LoRA. Khac Flux o hai diem:
1. SDXL chay CFG THAT (7.0) nen NEGATIVE PROMPT CO TAC DUNG.
Flux schnell chay CFG=1, phan negative bi bo qua hoan toan.
2. Co LoraLoader. LoRA line art la thu duy nhat HUAN LUYEN LAI model
cho dung viec nay - manh hon moi cau chu trong prompt.
De TRONG truong 'lora' trong cong thuc sach thi studio TU GO node
LoraLoader ra va noi thang checkpoint vao sampler. Khong can hai file
SDXL can 25-30 buoc va CFG 6-8. Da dat san trong file .api.json.
De trong STUDIO_STEPS va STUDIO_GUIDANCE thi dung nguyen gia tri do.
